question: Which of the following is amended by the Taxation Laws (Amendment Bill, 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Income Tax Act, 1961.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Income **Tax Act of 1961 governs income tax **collection in India. It specifies how income tax will be levied, administered, collected, and **recovered.**
 
• In order to replace the** Income Tax Act of 1961 and the Wealth Tax Act of 1957,** the Government of India introduced a draught bill known as the** "Direct Taxes Code."**
 
• The** Taxation Laws (Amendment) Act, 2021** was approved by the president on August 13, 2021, and it makes changes to the Finance Act of 2012 and the** Income Tax Act, of 1961.**
 
• The** "retrospective taxation"** that was enacted with the Finance Act of 2012 was repealed by the 2021 Act. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **19th century saw the establishment of British dominance** in India. The British government faced a severe financial crisis following the **Mutiny of 1857.**
 
• Sir J**ames Wilson, the first finance minister of British India,** proposed the first Income-tax Act in February 1860 to raise money for the treasury.
 
• **Income from the previous year** is subject to taxation at the applicable rate or rates in the next assessment year.
